content.name: Cathal Brennan
profile: Site engineer with five years on residential and commercial builds in the greater Dublin area, most recently a two-hundred-unit apartment scheme. Setting out, quality control and subcontractor coordination are the core of the job, and I keep the paperwork as tidy as the site.
skills: Setting out (Leica total station, GPS rover)

details: Final year project on precast facade tolerances

experience.title: Site Engineer
bullets: Setting out and levels for a two-hundred-unit apartment scheme across four blocks, from piling through to facade.
Coordinated the precast, steel and window subcontractors on a shared programme and chaired the weekly lookahead meeting.
Ran the quality inspection and sign-off process in Procore, closing out over two thousand inspection records.
Temporary works coordinator for the scheme's tower crane bases and formwork.

experience.title: Junior Site Engineer
bullets: Setting out for housing estates and a primary school extension under a senior engineer.
Kept the site diary, delivery records and as-built drawings for the handover file.
Trained as the site's first aider and manual handling instructor.

additional: Full clean driving licence, category B
